vedic_reference.note: From the Sanskrit roots स्था (sthā) and स्थानम् (sthānam), meaning 'to stand' and 'place, position' respectively.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shresthav is often used to acknowledge and honor the exceptional qualities of an individual. It can be used as a title of respect for someone who has achieved great success or holds a position of authority in their community or profession. It places a high value on personal excellence and success.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Shresthav holds a deeper meaning. It symbolizes the ideal state of enlightenment - being the best that one can be, according to one's unique divine potential. It represents the journey towards the ultimate goal of self-realization and self-transcendence. The name Shresthav is a reminder to continually strive for spiritual growth, to be the best version of ourselves, and to honor the divine spark within us all.

historical_references.reference: The Shresthavs were a prominent Kshatriya (warrior) clan in the northern Indian region of Uttar Pradesh during the medieval period. They held significant power and influence in the political landscape of the region.
historical_references.context: Political power and influence in northern India

historical_references.reference: The Shresthavs are also mentioned in ancient Hindu texts, particularly the Mahabharata, as descendants of the lunar dynasty (Chandra Vansha). In the epic, they are listed among the great warriors and noble families of ancient India.
historical_references.context: Ancestry and nobility in Hindu epics
